title: Hyrox expands global race calendar, plans more multi-week events
claim: Reports the 2026/27 calendar of 107 race weekends on six continents, new hosts including San Diego and Portland, Oregon, and multi-day residencies to meet record demand.
excerpt: Search summary: 107 race weekends; new host cities San Diego, Portland (Oregon), Bari, Nagoya; some events expand into residencies of up to 10 days. WebFetch of this page was blocked.
